items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: I had been working with them earlier

ctx.x: I was afraid you were going to say that. They’re just copy and pasting, right?

Copy/paste. I said, “What do you mean you got it, man?” “Yeah, yeah, well” – I remember doing this one – I’m not mentioning who they were but they wanted something timbale fills. And I did the timbale fills on the first chorus. They says, “Okay we’re good.” I said, “Bro, you’re not good, I mean you’re going to play the same fills” I mean whatever. You know. You know you don’t have to argue with them. I’ll tell you another – you want to know a story that’s kind of crazy? I go in to do a session. And I had already…
